fastest.name: Fastest Minimum-Duration Corridor
fastest.explanation: FASTEST route minimizes total mission duration (34.5 days / 829 hours). It operates at Sagar Kanya's peak service speed (mean SOG 9.15 kt), leveraging eastward Antarctic Circumpolar Current velocity vectors. Fuel consumption is higher (821.8 MT) due to cubic propeller resistance at 9+ knots.

shortest.name: Shortest Great-Circle Corridor
shortest.explanation: SHORTEST route minimizes total geographic distance (6544.6 NM), saving 18.3 NM compared to FASTEST. It closely traces great-circle geodesic segments between Cape Town, Bharati, and Maitri. SOG is held at nominal cruising (7.0 kt), taking 43.4 days and consuming 500.7 MT of fuel.

safest.name: Safest Low-Ice Outer Corridor
safest.explanation: SAFEST route prioritizes safety and risk minimization (mean risk 0.231). It maintains an offshore standoff distance from coastal fast ice and heavy iceberg accumulation zones in Prydz Bay and Queen Maud Land, sailing 6794.4 NM in 48.5 days at moderate speed.

fuel_efficient.name: Fuel-Efficient Slow-Steaming Corridor
fuel_efficient.explanation: FUEL-EFFICIENT route demonstrates hydrodynamic slow-steaming at 5.37 kt average speed. Because propulsion power scales with the cube of speed (P ∝ V³), dropping from 9.15 kt to 5.37 kt cuts propulsion power by ~78%, yielding the lowest fuel burn of all alternatives (351.7 MT, saving 57% fuel vs FASTEST).

balanced.explanation: BALANCED route represents the multi-criteria Pareto compromise (48.0 days, 473.4 MT fuel, 0.115 risk score). It balances transit time, bunker endurance, and risk exposure, providing a robust operational itinerary.
